response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems engineer with genuine geospatial project experience (GISCollective) and some low-level C/C++ background, but his recent professional work is overwhelmingly in TypeScript/Node.js web development, with no evidence of modern C++/Rust production work, distributed-systems routing infrastructure, or navigation-tiling pipelines required for this role.
strengths: Long-standing personal/open-source involvement in geospatial (GIS) data platforms
Broad technical range including some C/C++ and D systems-level experience (e.g., NI LabWindows, low-latency DLang services)
Strong track record of ownership, craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD) and cross-domain adaptability
concerns: No recent or substantial commercial C++ or Rust experience matching the 'modern C++' requirement
No direct experience with routing/navigation tile pipelines or real-time traffic data integration
Career trajectory has moved further into web/full-stack and AI tooling, away from systems/geospatial engineering

key_factors.factor: Lack of modern C++/Rust production experience
Relevant geospatial side-project (GISCollective) and some low-level systems background
